meta.name: vibe-build
meta.description: Build your MVP following the AGENTS.md plan. Use when the user wants to start building, implement features, or says "build my MVP", "start coding", or "implement the project".

copy.tagline: 按计划自动构建项目最小可行产品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有一个开发计划，想快速把想法变成可运行的代码。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically build your MVP following a plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a development plan and want to turn ideas into working code quickly.

howto.what: Claude 会按照 AGENTS.md 中的计划，逐步构建你的最小可行产品（MVP）。它会先检查必要的文件，然后每完成一个功能就进行测试，并更新进度。
howto.when: 当你说“构建我的MVP”、“开始编码”或“实施项目”，或者你想开始构建或实现功能时触发。

say.text: 按照 AGENTS.md 开始构建我的 MVP。
say.note: Claude 会读取计划并开始执行。
Claude 会先提出计划，等你批准后开始编码。

howto.what_en: Claude will build your MVP incrementally following the AGENTS.md plan. It checks required files, implements one feature at a time, runs tests, and updates progress.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "build my MVP", "start coding", or "implement the project", or when you want to start building or implement features.

say_en.text: Start building my MVP following AGENTS.md.
say_en.note: Claude reads the plan and begins execution.
Claude proposes a plan, waits for approval, then codes.
